purpose: Finite source-exact AX-2 narration inputs for the ENTIRE A00 m81245 subtraction module, including metadata, objectives, readiness, all instruction, 125 exercises, 83 supplied solutions, 42 answer absences, self-check and outer glossary. Translation/accessibility workflow only; not training data.

scope.excluded_from_completion_claim: Every other A00/A10 module and the remaining AX-2 production workflow remain unfinished.

matching_contract.dispatch: Fail closed on exact module m81245, source path/ID or MathML ordinal, and canonical tree hash. Every expected reading below is finite.
matching_contract.tree_hash_algorithm: build_units.tree_key: deep-copy, clear root tail, XML canonicalize with strip_text=True and rewrite_prefixes=True, SHA256 UTF-8.
matching_contract.source_release_precedence: Use the pinned Indonesian A00 release media first. All 55 effective referenced bytes were read and proved byte-identical to the canonical English Git pin; no fallback or override was needed.
matching_contract.implementation_status: Input draft only; no production descriptor, reader/audio build, synthesis or installed tests claimed.

decisions: kurang/dikurangi is directly attested; the school compound pangurangan remains source-defined and provisional.
suda/nyuda has an explicit numerical reducing sense; subtraction remains ngurangi rather than silently standardizing a new compound.
silih/nyilih supports borrowing; do not conflate it with the replacement homonym. One higher-place unit is exchanged for ten lower-place units without changing total value.
simpen is ordinary storage; simpenan is a provisional carry label only and is not used for subtraction borrowing.
kacèk is an attested difference alternative, while selisih is retained as the source-aligned school loan.
sisa and turah are attested remainder/leftover alternatives; exact contextual target prose remains authoritative.
Number readings retain C07 salawé and sèket, C24 éwu/sèwu, and actual place-value compounds; lexical evidence does not certify prosody.

Dari kiri ke kanan, setiap kolom berjudul operasi, notasi, ekspresi, dibaca sebagai, dan hasil.
